text: Acceleration is the rate at which velocity changes with time.
The SI unit of acceleration is metres per second squared.
Velocity describes the rate and direction of change in position over time.
Newton's second law states that net force equals mass multiplied by acceleration.
Inertia is the tendency of an object to resist a change in its state of motion.
Gravity is an attractive force between objects with mass.
Kinetic energy is the energy an object has because of its motion.
Potential energy is stored energy associated with position or configuration.
